activities.body: Linda called: existing deck boards are soft near the back door and two joists are rotten. Roughly 16 x 12 ft, wants composite boards. No permit needed if we keep the same footprint.

Site visit: kitchen at 305 Lee St

activities.body: Measured up: 14 ft galley, load-bearing wall between kitchen and dining. Needs an engineer's letter and a beam before we can open it up. Raj wants quartz tops and to keep the existing window.

activities.subject: Get structural engineer's price for the beam
Site walk with Victor at Ironbark Row

activities.body: Quote sent for a full restoration: replace cracked tiles, re-bed and re-point ridges, new valley flashings. Megan is comparing with one other quote and wants an answer on the 10-year workmanship warranty.

activities.subject: Follow up the roof quote with Megan
Check Tanya received the driveway quote
activities.outcome: Received; waiting on the homeowner's sign-off

activities.subject: Walk-through of the clinic plans with Mike

activities.body: Mesa needs the fit-out finished before the tenant's lease start. Plumbing for four operatories is the long-lead item. Quote assumes after-hours work for the slab cuts.
Tiles and vanity delivered to the garage. Carlos is staying with family during the work; lockbox code is in the job folder.

activities.subject: Order the shower screen (8-day lead time)
Confirm lumber drop at lot 14 for 6:30am
Pre-start call with Greg Holloway
activities.outcome: Slab inspection passed; site is ready

activities.subject: Chase the 20% deposit from Sarah Kowalski

activities.body: Permit approved by the city. Start locked in for crew A once the deposit clears. Excavator needed on day one for the footings.
Wall finished: 42 ft of block wall with drainage behind. Diane paid half on completion and the rest is due in 30 days as agreed.

activities.subject: Call Ben about the overdue Elk Hollow invoice

activities.body: Replaced 40 sq ft of drywall and the subfloor under the dishwasher. Insurance assessor signed off the photos.
Kelly went with a cheaper quote that excluded egress windows. Worth a check-in next spring.
Jordan chose another contractor who could start a week sooner.
Summit Ridge has 22 more lots in this phase. Owen wants a fixed framing rate per square foot for the next round.

activities.subject: Send Highline the quarterly maintenance schedule
Check in with Tom about the gutter guards
activities.outcome: Happy with the work; wants a deck quote in spring
